answer_1.quote: We propose a novel ... pseudo translations using an MT model with constrained beam search (CBSQE). ... We generate pseudo translations using a neural machine translation (NMT) with the beam search algorithm (BS) and obtain labels by matching these translations with corresponding references using TER tools.
answer_1.outputs: pseudo translations and corresponding QE labels (sentence-level HTER scores and word-level OK/BAD tags)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the sentence-level task using Pearson's correlation coefficient. For the word-level task, WMT19 used F1-MULT as the primary metric, while WMT20/21 conducted the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) as the primary metric. We also provide results of MAE and RMSE metrics.
